retrieval_method: Deterministic extraction by build_fixture.py from the checksum-pinned expt_gap.json.gz Figshare payload
retrieval_timestamp_utc: unknown: source identity is fixed by DOI and payload hashes
selection_rule: In source order, retain the first 100 unique rows with a finite strictly positive gap and an ordinary unparenthesized formula matching (Element amount)*; no outcome ranking or model fit enters selection.
selection_scope: source rows 2 through 193 are scanned; 100 rows pass
deduplication_rule: Retain the first eligible occurrence of each ordinary formula; duplicate formulas are skipped before the 100-row limit is applied
known_source_dependence: Shared literature sources and chemical families may be dependent; this convenience slice is not treated as a population sample
representativeness: Alphabetically concentrated convenience fixture for a geometry demonstrator; not a representative Matbench sample or benchmark fold.
license_status: The authoritative Figshare dataset record declares the expt_gap dataset under the MIT licence
rights_basis: The authoritative Figshare record for dataset 9765779 identifies expt_gap as a public dataset under the MIT licence.
redistribution_decision: Bundled under the MIT licence declared by the Figshare dataset record, with Hacking Materials attribution, dataset DOI, source-file identity and transformation rule retained.

split.algorithm: SHA256 each unique formula; sort by (hash, formula, source_row); first 70 train, final 30 held out

model.target_measure: graph posterior over alpha with respect to d alpha

detcorr_routes: callable residual with central finite differences
validation.finite_penalty_route: pointwise-corrected direct local trapezoid quadrature over all 30 held-out states
validation.unit_invariance: eV/E0=1 eV compared with meV/E0=1000 meV
